label: Parte 3
subtitle: Comparar 2 fotos + 2 preguntas · 45 seg cada respuesta
objetivo: Comparar y contrastar dos situaciones. Variedad gramatical y conectores de contraste (whereas, while, however).

pasos.title: Apertura comparativa
pasos.template: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to [tema general], but in completely different contexts. Let me take a closer look at each of them.
pasos.trick: Aperturas alternativas: 'Straight away, I can tell that both pictures...' / 'From the very first glance, I notice that...'

pasos.title: Similitudes
pasos.template: Both pictures show [elemento común], and in both of them, the people seem [sentimiento común].
pasos.trick: Si no encuentras una similitud clara, di 'people interacting' o 'people enjoying their time'. Funciona para casi cualquier comparación.

pasos.title: Diferencias (lo más importante)
pasos.grammar: Conectores: whereas, while, on the other hand
pasos.template: However, the main difference is that in the first picture [detalle foto 1], whereas in the second one [detalle foto 2]. Another clear difference is [segunda diferencia].

opciones: several colleagues are interacting in an office
the setting is indoors and formal
a person is working alone from home
the setting is outdoors and relaxed

pasos.trick: 'Whereas' > 'while' > 'but'. Cuanto más arriba, más nivel demuestras. Memoriza 'whereas' y úsalo seguro.

pasos.title: Opinión personal con preferencia
pasos.grammar: Condicional 2: If I had to choose, I would prefer...
pasos.template: If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards [foto 1/2], because [razón sólida]. It's far more [adjetivo comparativo] for someone like me.

opciones: it fits the way I work

pasos.trick: 'Lean towards' es phrasal verb B2 (= inclinarse por). Mucho mejor que 'prefer'.
pasos.warning: 'If I would choose, I would...' → ERROR. Condicional 2: 'If I HAD to choose, I WOULD...'.

kits_universales.label: Conectores de similitud
items: what they have in common is...

temas.label: Office vs Home work
temas.descripcion_fotos: Foto 1: oficina moderna. Foto 2: persona trabajando desde casa.
preguntas: Compare these two pictures.
Which working environment would you prefer? Why?
How has remote work changed our lives?
temas.respuesta_modelo: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to work, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people engaged in their professional tasks, and in both of them they seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture several colleagues are interacting in an office, whereas in the second one a person is working alone from home. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards working from home, because it gives me more flexibility. It's far more convenient for someone like me.

temas.label: Books vs Digital reading
temas.descripcion_fotos: Foto 1: gente con libros impresos. Foto 2: gente con tablets / ebooks.
preguntas: Compare these two pictures.
Which way of reading do you prefer? Why?
Will printed books disappear in the future?
temas.respuesta_modelo: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to reading, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people engaged in books, and in both of them they seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture readers are using printed books, whereas in the second one they're reading from digital devices. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards printed books, because the feel of paper helps me concentrate. It's far more enjoyable for someone like me.

temas.label: City life vs Countryside

preguntas: Compare these two pictures.
Where would you prefer to live? Why?
Why do so many people move to big cities?
temas.respuesta_modelo: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to where we choose to live, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show daily life, and in both of them people seem comfortable in their environment. However, the main difference is that in the first picture the setting is a busy urban area, whereas in the second one it's a peaceful rural landscape. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards the countryside, because it gives me a sense of calm. It's far more relaxing for someone like me.

How do you usually shop?

Both pictures show people purchasing products, and in both of them they seem engaged. However, the main difference is that in the first picture customers are browsing in a physical shop, whereas in the second one a person is buying from a laptop at home. temas.label: Group activity vs Individual

Do you prefer doing things alone or in a group?

Both pictures show people engaged in what they're doing, and in both of them they seem at ease. However, the main difference is that in the first picture a group of people are sharing an activity, whereas in the second one a person is doing it alone. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards group activities, because they bring out the best in me. It's far more rewarding for someone like me.
